name: NOAA U.S. temperature and precipitation assessment — July 2026
known_limitations: National and state climate ranks describe measured temperature and precipitation, not project-specific damages, service failures, adaptation performance, causal attribution, or future local conditions.
source_owner: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information
automation_notes: Preserve the July 2026 observation period, 132-year comparison record, later data correction, and local-attribution boundary.
factual_nucleus: NOAA reports a July 2026 contiguous-U.S. average temperature of 76.9°F, 3.3°F above the 20th-century average and the warmest July and month in the 132-year record; nationwide precipitation averaged 2.55 inches, 0.23 inch below average.
notes: Phase 177 monthly climate assessment checked 2026-09-01; page updated August 12, 2026.
